hero.tagline: Where starlight whispers through the swirling firmament

moon.label: I. The Moon
moon.heading: The dark side no one sees
moon.intro: Every face has a hidden hemisphere — thoughts unspoken, feelings folded inward like petals at dusk. The Moon knows this secret well: it keeps one side forever veiled, yet its pull shapes the tides of every ocean and every heart. What truths do you cradle in your own dark side?

philosophy.label: II. The Waves
philosophy.heading: The river does not boast of the ocean
philosophy.intro: The ego mistakes itself for the whole sea — a wave convinced of its own separateness. But arrogance is heavy armor; it slows the warrior and muffles the music of the depths. True strength arrives not through self-assertion but through the surrender to something vast and unnamed.

gita.label: III. The Battlefield
gita.heading: The war within — dharma versus desire
gita.intro: Before the first arrow flew, Krishna offered Arjuna something rarer than victory: a new way of seeing. The battlefield is not Kurukshetra but the cusp of every choice — where duty calls and desire answers back. To act without clinging to results is not indifference; it is the deepest form of freedom.

shiva.label: IV. The Dance
shiva.heading: Time as jewel in matted locks
shiva.intro: In the silence before the drum speaks, in the pause between one breath and the next — there is Shiva. Not the destroyer of old stories but the dancer who makes destruction and creation a single gesture. His stillness is not absence; it is the eye at the center of every storm.

art.label: V. The Canvas
art.heading: Bridges across the abyss of silence
art.intro: A lily does not ask whether its reflection in the water is worthy of being seen. It simply opens. So too with creation — the brushstroke, the note, the written word — each is a bridge thrown across the gap between inner silence and outer form. Art begins where self-consciousness ends.
